The '''Taurin Delta''' was a river delta formed by the [[Unnh River]] where it entered an ocean on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]].<ref name="SWG" /> The [[Temple of the Blueleaf Cluster/Legends|Temple of the Blueleaf Cluster]] was located on the landmass.<ref name="SWG:TTotB" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Taurin Delta was a designated planetary region in the [[2003]] [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'',<ref name="SWG" /> prior to the [[Star Wars video games|game's]] closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref>
